title: Ratecard cutover conductor and risk triage for SKU & limits transition
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Serve as the cross-functional conductor for the ratecard & SKU re-pricing cutover. Scope includes SKU renaming and consolidation, per-route and token limits adjustments, billing entitlements migration, release notes and changelog coordination, sales enablement materials, customer migration comms, and post-cutover verification. This ticket owns the orchestration timeline, the risk matrix, the rollback criteria, and the public-facing communications schedule. Exclusions: individual engineering implementation tasks (tracked on ENG tickets), detailed legal text (handled by Legal), and downstream third-party reseller integrations.

Proposed a two-phase cutover: internal pilot -> worldwide cutover. Scheduling risk review with finance and billing engineering.

acceptance_criteria: All affected products show new SKU labels in console and API documentation
Billing events for a representative test cohort reconcile with finance reports within accepted variance thresholds
Quota enforcements reflect new limits in both hosted API and Dedicated deployments
Public release notes and changelog published and linked from console
Sales enablement kit (slides, FAQ, migration checklist) published and training scheduled
Rollback procedure documented, tested in staging, and able to execute within defined maintenance window
Monitoring dashboards and alerts for anomalies (billing spikes, quota errors, failed migrations) are live and validated
